geneva-chamonix-and-grand-st-bernard-doo.title: Geneva · Chamonix and Grand St Bernard Doorway
geneva-chamonix-and-grand-st-bernard-doo.story: Alpine scenery with border-road discipline. Out of Chamonix-Mont-Blanc and back again: 235 km, roughly 4 h 31 in the saddle. The climbs: Col des Montets and Grand St Bernard approach. It tops out at about 2,450 m. Col des Montets and Great St Bernard Pass are subject to seasonal closure - check it is open before you set off. It crosses France, Switzerland and Italy - carry ID and check vignette or toll rules. The passes are the reason to go.

scenicChapters.title: Col des Montets
scenicChapters.narrative: 30 km that neither climbs nor drops much. The road settles into the ground rather than fighting it — this is where a day makes up time without anyone trying. Third and fourth, and very little else.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.title: Great St Bernard Pass Road
scenicChapters.narrative: For 49 km this is Great St Bernard Pass Road, a road with a name of its own and a reason for it. Expect company on a summer weekend. Early is better than fast.
scenicChapters.riderNote: Check the pass is open before you commit to it.

scenicChapters.narrative: The ground tilts up and stays tilted for 112 km. 1376 m of it, taken steadily rather than in one wall — a steady rhythm suits this better than bursts. The height arrives whether you hurry or not.

scenicChapters.title: Top of the World Highway
